transcript: I partnered with Makewish to surprise a bunch of kids and they have no idea what I have in store for them. Come on in everybody! Each of these kids is facing a serious illness, so we had to find a way to give them the best day ever. How many of you have ever wanted to be in a video? Me! Me! Yeah? So we recreated some of our most popular games from our videos and made sure everyone went home with a prize. You're going home with a brand new PlayStation! But to make this unforgettable, the kids got to meet their favorite creators, including some of the biggest YouTubers. And we have one more surprise. Avengers Campus is yours. I am so grateful to meet each and every one of these kids. And if you want to help make a wish, it's simple. Go to wish.org to make someone's dream come true.
metadata_caption: We Made Make-A-Wish Kids’ Dreams Come True
